name: Maid Tantei Dille & Elle
original_name: メイド探偵 ディル＆エル
source:
Saito, an undistinguished high-school boy, finds a part-time job in a maid detective agency!?
Is he able to respond to a client's request with Dille and Elle, two beautiful maid-uniform-wearing girls?
And the fate of his love...?

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/event/maid/game]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
斋藤是一个毫不起眼的高中男生，竟然在一家女仆侦探事务所找到了兼职！？他能和两个穿着女仆制服的美少女迪尔和艾尔一起回应客户的委托吗？以及他的恋爱命运……？

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/event/maid/game]DLsite English[/url]]
